title: Aletheia’s Quest
summary: Investigating deceptive responses through internal activations and reasoning signals.
question: Can signals inside a language model help identify deceptive responses across different settings?
abstract: This competition project explores deception detection using residual-stream probes and reasoning signals. It considers how internal evidence can complement the model’s visible response.

The emphasis is on transfer and evaluation: a detector’s ranking and calibration can change across models and scenarios. A useful signal needs to survive those changes, rather than simply track cues specific to one dataset.
